# Code Anchors: The Fix Razor

- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.ts` — the bound as code: the status and base-resolution checks, the exactly-one-gained-entry count, and the byte-identity comparison ahead of the gained heading, exempting only the attribution line and trailing whitespace.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.spec.ts` — pins that a page created, deleted or renamed fails, that zero and two gained entries both fail, that an edit anywhere outside the gained entry fails, and that the mode is inert when not requested.
